diffs.diff: pin count: part has 4 (GND 3V SDA SCL), datasheet reading has 8 (RST 3V GND SDA SCL C B A)
diffs.evidence: The second reading listed the whole 2-row Feather header, but the Adafruit guide says the display needs only 3V, GND, SDA and SCL ('No other pins are required.'), A/B/C are three optional user buttons on Feather GPIOs, and RST is the Feather reset line that the schematic ties via closed jumper SJ1 to OLED RES#, which already has its own APX803 reset supervisor and 12 k pull-up, so the 4-pin STEMMA QT model is complete (RST and buttons are documented in SKILL.md and buildNotes).
